articles.title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
articles.desc: Tata Motors Ltd achieved a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue from operations rose significantly to ₹23,930 crore, up 42% from the previous year. Improved demand was driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity, according to managing director Girish Wagh. Consolidated profit also increased to ₹1,257 crore, aided by a drop in mark-to-market losses.

articles.title: Commerce minister Piyush Goyal discusses investment avenues with German companies
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal engaged with major German firms like Siemens Healthineers, Bayer, and Fresenius to discuss investments. He highlighted Bayer's plans for expansion and collaboration in India's healthcare ecosystem. Goyal also addressed opportunities for Fresenius to leverage India's talent for healthcare solutions. Furthermore, he explored ways to strengthen Siemens Healthineers' presence in the country. These discussions reflect India's growing relevance in the global healthcare market.

articles.title: Private sector activity hits four month high in October
articles.desc: India's private sector activity experienced significant growth in October, reaching a four-month high as new orders increased. The HSBC Flash India Composite Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 56.7, signaling expansion. Manufacturing output and new orders remained stable, while services activity saw notable improvement. Employment increased slightly, although firms showed caution in hiring due to adequate staffing levels. International demand contributed to growth, with export orders expanding significantly during this period.

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
articles.desc: The network is used by the Ukrainian military, sources say, and Trump says "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out".

articles.title: Target reached, but asset monetisation to continue: DIPAM secretary Arunish Chawla
articles.desc: "We have already identified a cluster of 10 national highways, which will provide the underlying capital asset. So, the second public InvITs is in the works and hopefully before the close of this financial year, it will also come to fruition," Chawla said. "We are also bringing down the equity (stake) in nationalised banks gradually to the minimum public shareholding norm of 75%, that is part of the mandate that we have to share the wealth with the people and also in line with regulations...we are moving ahead on that path."

articles.title: Soundcore’s latest noise-crushing headphones are on sale for a new low price
articles.desc: My colleague John Higgins considered Soundcore’s Space One some of the best budget noise-canceling headphones you could buy when they launched in 2023 — and their successor has only improved upon their winning formula, albeit with a $30 price increase. This expansion aims to enhance the measurement of labour-market data. The survey will enable better reporting and data collection on these aspects annually.

Key topics included fostering a robust domestic investment climate, ensuring effective capital movement for reform, and addressing cybersecurity needs within the financial sector.

articles.desc: "Apple India Private Limited provides and markets Apple brand products and software, and reported its revenues for the financial year 2025-26 at Rs 1,04,607 crore, a 32 per cent jump since the last financial year," Tofler said.

articles.desc: US Treasury yields rise after a sharp drop in the previous session, but the benchmark 10 year yield stays below 5% as lingering AI market concerns keep investors cautious. Recent geopolitical frictions have resulted in increased prices and supply chain issues, leading to policy changes. Currency fluctuations were observed, but measures by the Reserve Bank helped stabilize the rupee recently. Foreign Direct Investment remains robust, driven by significant inflows from major sources like the US and Singapore.

articles.desc: EAAA India Alternatives has successfully raised approximately Rs 360 crore from anchor investors prior to its IPO. This IPO is set to open for public subscription on October 26. The company will not receive any proceeds from the issue as it is an offer for sale. Prominent institutional investors and major domestic mutual fund houses participated in the anchor allocation.

It said the two countries could use their respective strengths in manufacturing, technology and innovation to deepen economic ties and create new growth opportunities.

articles.title: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on  strong interest income, lower funding costs
articles.desc: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore, driven by higher net interest income and lower funding costs. Assets under management grew 17%, while the board declared an interim dividend of Rs 6.50 per share.

articles.title: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
articles.desc: Shree Cement’s September-quarter net profit fell over 15% year-on-year to Rs 263 crore for the third consecutive quarterly decline. Revenue rose 24% and sales volumes increased 14%, but soaring fuel costs pressured profitability despite stronger premium product sales.

articles.desc: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 170 crore, supported by business growth, higher margins and improved gross asset quality. The bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100%, while loans and deposits expanded.

articles.title: RBI flags rising inflation risks from West Asia conflict, El Nino despite resilient Indian economy
articles.desc: India's external sector shows resilience due to a narrowing trade gap and comfortable foreign exchange reserves. Inflationary pressures have intensified due to geopolitical tensions and supply-side bottlenecks. The RBI reported an increase in both industry and services indicators, showcasing economic strength. The IMF has revised India's growth projection for 2026-27 to 7% based on resilient domestic demand. Global financial volatility has increased amid global challenges and rising inflation risks.

articles.desc: Mukesh Ambani’s Jio Platforms IPO attracted bids exceeding Rs 4.5 lakh crore, setting 12 records, including over 1.25 crore applications. Institutional and retail participation surged, making it India’s largest public offering, with allotment expected October 26 and listing October 28.

articles.desc: In its report, SBI said the RBI had consistently signalled its commitment to monetary tightening through its policy resolution, the Governor’s statement and the minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC). The liquidity infusion through repo auctions, however, appeared difficult to reconcile with this approach.

articles.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate eyes Rs 1,650 cr revenue from new project in Pune
articles.desc: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has announced plans to develop a housing project in Pune. This initiative will generate an estimated revenue of Rs 1,650 crore through a Joint Development Agreement. The project, located in Hinjewadi, spans 5.62 acres and features a total saleable area of approximately 1.25 million sq ft. Birla Estates, a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Real Estate, will oversee the project development.

articles.title: RBI does not target any specific Rupee level, focuses on curbing volatility, says Governor Sanjay Malhotra
articles.desc: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday said the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate or level for the rupee against the US dollar, stressing that its primary objective is to ensure orderly conditions in the foreign exchange market and prevent excessive volatility.

articles.title: SBI Cards Q2 profit jumps 75% YoY to Rs 778 crore as bad loan costs fall sharply
articles.desc: SBI Cards reported a 75% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 778 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by lower credit costs and improved asset quality. However, corporate card spending declined, receivables contracted, and net interest margins narrowed.

articles.title: PLFS set for fresh overhaul, govt seeks public & expert opinion on upcoming new things
articles.desc: The National Statistics Office (NSO), which has conducted the PLFS since 2017, plans to introduce the modifications from January 2027, when fresh samples for the 2027-2028 two-year period, designated Panel 6, will be drawn using an updated sampling frame.

articles.title: Satellite lights, Google searches cut state growth estimation errors by up to 62%: RBI study
articles.desc: RBI study indicates that combining night-time light data with Google search trends can improve state economic growth estimates. Researchers tested their model in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Karnataka, showing significant reductions in forecasting errors. This framework could help provide timely economic insights, as state data is often delayed. Night-time illumination proved to be a strong predictor of Gross State Value Added growth.

articles.title: Why US stocks are falling: Dow Jones crashes over 700 points as AI selloff, SpaceX fears hit markets
articles.desc: US stocks experienced a decline as AI related shares continued to selloff significantly over the week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell markedly, affecting overall investor sentiment in the market. Concerns regarding competition from SpaceX led to drops in major telecom stocks such as AT&T and Verizon. Meanwhile, energy stocks achieved record highs as oil prices rose amid ongoing supply concerns.

articles.title: Bharat Electronics among 4 Sensex stocks to hit 52-week lows; shares fall up to 9% in a month
articles.desc: Four Sensex stocks, including Bharat Electronics, NTPC, Power Grid Corporation and Hindustan Unilever, touched fresh 52-week lows on Friday as the benchmark index declined. The four stocks have fallen between about 6% and 9% over the past month, reflecting continued weakness in their share prices.

articles.title: Dr Reddy’s Q2 Results: Net profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 913 crore, revenue declines marginally
articles.desc: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories reported a 36% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 913.4 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue slipped 1.5%. North America weakness pressured performance, offset partly by growth in India and emerging markets, alongside biosimilar approvals and strategic partnerships.

articles.title: Explained: Why is Meta creating a new class of non-voting shares amid its AI growth?
articles.desc: Meta plans to create a new class of publicly traded non-voting stock, known as Class C shares, and distribute one Class C share for each existing Class A and Class B share - effectively splitting its stock two-for-one. The new shares are expected to begin trading in January 2027.

articles.title: Inflation stays high, growth slows, central bankers face a bigger challenge, says RBI Guv Malhotra
articles.desc: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra highlighted the challenges faced by central banks due to global uncertainties and supply chain issues. He noted the elevated global inflation and lower growth forecasts impacting monetary policy decisions worldwide. India entered this phase with strong macroeconomic fundamentals, maintaining growth at 7.8% despite rising inflation levels. The RBI's goal remains to achieve price stability while ensuring financial market order and health.

articles.desc: The news comes weeks after SK Hynix said it was reviewing various options to strengthen Solidigm's competitiveness, but that no decisions had been made.

Stakeholder consultations will be conducted to finalise the plan, which covers diverse aquatic ecosystems.

The 2036 bond yield rose to 7.4740%, indicating a broader trend of increasing yields. These developments may significantly affect India's import bill and inflation outlook.

articles.title: Despite global tensions, India’s business sentiment rebounds in Q2 FY27: NCAER
articles.desc: India's Business Confidence Index has risen to 107.8 in the second quarter of this fiscal year. The survey included 502 companies across six major cities, reflecting both large firms and MSMEs. All four key parameters evaluated by the index showed gains when compared to the previous quarter. NCAER indicated that confidence improved in expectations of economic conditions and financial health.

articles.title: Infosys ADRs crash 6% after Q2 results as revenue guidance cut spooks investors
articles.desc: Infosys ADRs fell 6.3% after the company lowered FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1-2%, despite September-quarter revenue beating estimates. Profit missed expectations, while large deal wins and AI revenue growth offered support amid cautious technology spending.

articles.title: Market wrap: Eternal, Apollo Hospital, Shriram Finance, Adani Enterprises among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
articles.desc: Indian equity markets fell for a fourth consecutive session, with the Nifty 50 closing at 22,600 and Sensex at 73,123.83. Small-cap, mid-cap and metal stocks slumped as bearish technical signals heightened concerns about further selling pressure.

articles.title: Jio IPO becomes first public issue globally to cross 1 crore applications; record puts spotlight on depth of India’s retail investor base
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has achieved a remarkable milestone, garnering over one crore applications for its upcoming initial public offering. This surge signifies a burgeoning interest from India's retail investors in technology sectors. With the IPO set to debut on October 28, maintaining this enthusiasm is crucial. The communication strategies employed mirror those found in consumer marketing, urging potential investors to evaluate their financial objectives carefully before engaging with the IPO.

articles.desc: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $5 billion to reach $721.02 billion for the week ending October 16. Previously, reserves declined by $8.578 billion to an amount of $726.027 billion. The decline in reserves reflects ongoing economic conditions impacting forex stability within the country. This trend indicates a continued volatility in India's foreign exchange market and its implications for the economy.

articles.title: AI stocks: Midterm elections could threaten AI trade as data center backlash grows
articles.desc: Public opposition to US data centers and the November midterm elections could reshape AI infrastructure investment. Increased regulatory scrutiny, rising electricity costs and construction delays may pressure technology stocks, utilities and power infrastructure companies, despite continued strong AI spending.

articles.title: Infosys Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore; co lowers revenue guidance

articles.desc: In the second quarter of this fiscal year, IndusInd Bank reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,176 crore, showcasing a remarkable turnaround from a loss of Rs 445 crore in the same quarter last year. The bank's net interest income increased by 4% year-on-year to Rs 4,569 crore, driven by enhanced asset quality, while gross non-performing assets decreased to 2.73% of gross advances, indicating robust profitability and growth momentum.

articles.title: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: Co swings to black with  Rs 1,254 crore profit; revenue jumps 37% YoY
articles.desc: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: The improvement in profitability was driven by lower mark-to-market losses on investments in Tata Capital Ltd. The company reported a strong net cash position of Rs 15,900 crore as of September 30, 2026.

articles.title: Rupee little changed this week as oil-fueled declines wipe out early gains
articles.desc: The Indian rupee experienced a decline for the second day in a row as rising oil prices dampened market confidence. Following a brief uptick at the start of trading, the rupee ended lower against the US dollar. Brent crude prices have surged to a five-month peak, raising worries about energy supply interruptions. This led to a pullback from technology stocks as investors flocked towards safer investments like US Treasuries.

articles.title: Global Market: Eurozone bond markets stabilise after volatile week
articles.desc: Eurozone government bonds stabilised after a volatile week as investors balanced sovereign debt concerns against safe-haven demand amid uncertainty over AI investments and global growth. French borrowing costs remain under pressure ahead of key central bank policy decisions.

articles.title: India’s labour survey to soon include platform workers and unpaid household work
articles.desc: India will update its Periodic Labour Force Survey starting January 2027 to enhance data collection. The modified sampling design aims to improve the identification of digital platform workers and unpaid household activities. Additionally, the updated sampling frame will reflect changes in urbanization and administrative boundaries. New questions will capture information on unpaid caregiving and volunteer work. Stakeholders are invited to provide feedback before the new sampling period begins.

articles.title: JSW Steel Q2 Results: Net profit rockets 225% YoY to Rs 5,279 crore; revenue rises 21%
articles.desc: JSW Steel Q2 Results:  JSW Steel reported a 225% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,279 crore, while revenue rose 21% to Rs 54,486 crore. EBITDA climbed 39% to Rs 9,941 crore, with crude steel production and steel sales hitting record highs. However, shares fell around 3% after results.

articles.title: Adani Power Q2 Results: Profit zooms 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore; revenue jumps 45%
articles.desc: Adani Power has reported an impressive consolidated net profit of Rs 6,919 crore for the second quarter of FY27, which marks a striking 134% increase from last year's profit of Rs 2,953 crore during the same period. Additionally, their operational revenue surged to Rs 19,439 crore, representing a 45% growth from Rs 13,457 crore the previous year.

articles.title: Global Market: European stocks edge lower as Kering slumps, oil prices rise

articles.title: Mozambique eyes India partnership to boost agro-processing, expand rice trade across Southern Africa
articles.desc: Mozambique is set to elevate its agricultural collaboration with India, tapping into mutual strengths in agro-processing. Secretary Antonio Do Rosario Grispos emphasized that India's rice imports are crucial for ensuring food security in Mozambique. This partnership aims to enhance trade routes via Mozambique's ports, fostering regional commerce and agricultural growth while strengthening historical ties with India as a strategic ally.

articles.title: Global Market: French bond selloff raises debt concerns across Europe amid social unrest

Rising borrowing costs are spreading to Italy and Belgium, intensifying concerns over eurozone debt sustainability, fiscal reforms and the region’s financial stability amid mounting economic pressures and uncertainty.

articles.title: From mercury to gold? This San Francisco startup claims it can produce yellow metal at will
articles.desc: San Francisco-based startup Marathon Fusion claims to have converted mercury into stable gold using fusion-generated neutrons, at a rate 10 times the record set by CERN in 2025. However, it has not disclosed the quantity of gold produced, leaving the commercial potential of the breakthrough unclear.

articles.title: India must shift from rice volume to value, says Food Processing Minister Chirag Paswan
articles.desc: India has progressed in rice production and is now focusing on value addition and food processing. Food Processing Industries Minister Chirag Paswan outlined the need for improved quality and sustainability in the rice value chain. The government aims to enhance rice exports while promoting innovation in processing technologies. Strengthening agricultural links to industry is essential for achieving rural prosperity and increasing farmer incomes.

articles.title: Sterlite Technologies Q2 Results: Profit surges 12,817% YoY to Rs 517 crore, revenue jumps 145%
articles.desc: Sterlite Technologies reported a 12,817% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 517 crore, while revenue surged 145% to a record Rs 2,529 crore. Strong demand for AI-ready digital infrastructure, improved margins and a one-time tariff refund gain supported performance, as its open order book reached Rs 35,274 crore.

articles.title: Rubio turns to small Indian town as US faces high oil prices
articles.desc: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio pushed a business and energy agenda over diplomacy on his second trip to India this year.

articles.title: D-Street bleeds! Market value of all BSE-listed firms falls below Rs 450 lakh crore for first time since April. More pain ahead?
articles.desc: The market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies fell below Rs 450 lakh crore for the first time since April as Sensex and Nifty extended losses for a fourth straight session. Nearly Rs 25 lakh crore has been wiped out this week, with soaring crude prices and rising bond yields weighing on sentiment.

articles.title: Silver prices slide below Rs 2 lakh/kg, down nearly 55% from Jan peak. What’s behind the rapid selloff?
articles.desc: MCX silver prices fell below Rs 2 lakh per kg after a sharp two-day decline, as a stronger dollar, elevated bond yields and hawkish US Federal Reserve expectations weighed on sentiment. Fresh import permits and industrial demand remain key factors for the outlook.

articles.title: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
articles.desc: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

articles.title: Global Market: Anthropic presses ahead with November IPO as AI listings face delays
articles.desc: Anthropic is preparing for a potential mid-November IPO despite market volatility, rising interest rates and concerns over AI spending. With a possible $1.5 trillion valuation, its listing could test investor appetite as several AI infrastructure companies postpone or shelve offerings.

articles.title: Global Market: Bank Indonesia defends policy mix after market confusion
articles.desc: Bank Indonesia has defended its latest policy package combining an unchanged benchmark rate, a higher deposit facility rate and reserve requirement cuts. The central bank says the measures aim to improve monetary policy transmission, boost banking liquidity and support credit growth.

articles.title: The Indian workers filming their work to train AI
articles.desc: Indian workers are being paid to film themselves at work and the footage is used to train AI.

articles.title: Jio Platforms IPO creates history: First issue globally to cross 1 crore applications
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has received over 1 crore applications, setting a global record for investor participation ahead of its October 23 closing. The Rs 30,213-crore issue was subscribed 7.49 times by 12:36 pm on Friday, led by strong demand from qualified institutional buyers and non-institutional investors.

articles.title: Nasdaq CEO flags IPO slowdown amid market volatility
articles.desc: The IPO market is grappling with hurdles stemming from macroeconomic instability and fluctuating market conditions that are influencing corporate strategies. Numerous firms have either delayed or abandoned their public listing intentions lately. Nevertheless, Nasdaq maintains a sturdy and vibrant pipeline for future listings, even as analysts caution that a revival in IPO activity likely won't materialize until 2026 without a surge in investor interest.

articles.title: This Tata Group stock plunged 10% a day after rallying 19% post Q2 results. Do you own?
articles.desc: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) shares plunged on Friday, giving up some gains after rallying 19% in the previous session following its Q2 results. The stock fell to Rs 34.24 on the NSE. The company reported a net loss of Rs 59 crore in Q2 FY27, narrowing from Rs 321 crore a year earlier and Rs 72 crore in the previous quarter. Despite the improvement, the stock has declined over 30% in 2026 so far and 59% in three years.

articles.title: Broader markets crash! Small, midcap indices tumble up to 4%. Why analysts are sounding the alarm
articles.desc: Smallcap and midcap stocks plunged up to 4% on Friday, extending a sharp weekly selloff as analysts warned that valuations remain difficult to justify. The Nifty Smallcap 250 index has fallen around 8% this week, while the Nifty Midcap 100 is down 6%, despite a resilient earnings growth outlook.

articles.title: Cyient shares rally 9% after Q2 revenue rises 25%; board declares Rs 12/sh interim dividend
articles.desc: Cyient shares surged on Friday after the company reported a 25% year-on-year rise in consolidated revenue to Rs 2,235 crore in Q2 FY27. Net profit declined 8% to Rs 132 crore. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share, while its DET business reported stronger revenue and order intake.

articles.title: Nippon Silver ETF, other silver ETFs slide up to 4% as silver prices tumble. Here’s why
articles.desc: Silver ETFs tumble up to 4% as India permits 6,500 metric tonnes of silver imports over six months, raising expectations of easing domestic supply tightness and premiums. Higher interest rates, bond yields and a firm dollar add to pressure on bullion prices.

articles.title: Infosys Q2 Results Live Updates: Infosys Q2 net profit jumps 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore, revenue rises 11%; co declares interim dividend of Rs 26/sh
Safe-haven demand pushes Japan’s 10-year yield to two-month low
articles.desc: Japanese government bonds saw a rally on Friday, leading to the benchmark 10-year yield hitting a two-month low. This surge occurred in response to a global selloff in tech stocks, prompting investors to flock to safer investment options. The approaching Bank of Japan policy meeting is the center of attention as market watchers analyze the implications for inflation and possible interest rate shifts.

articles.title: Infinx plans $300 million IPO in India, appoints three bankers
articles.desc: Infinx Technology Solutions has appointed Kotak Mahindra Capital, Nomura and Avendus to manage its proposed $300 million IPO, targeting FY28. Backed by KKR and Norwest Venture Partners, the healthcare IT firm provides AI-powered revenue cycle management services and has expanded through strategic investments and acquisitions, including i3 Verticals’ healthcare business.

articles.title: Tech Mahindra, SpaceXSI partner to accelerate AI-powered software engineering
articles.desc: The company said it will combine its global engineering, enterprise transformation and AI consulting capabilities with SpaceXSI's AI-powered development platform to help enterprises expand application modernisation, streamline software development and improve code quality.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal discusses investment opportunities with Bayer, Fresenius
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal held meetings with Bayer and Fresenius executives to discuss investment opportunities in India's healthcare sector. During these discussions, Goyal explored Bayer's expansion plans and potential collaborations in healthcare. He also examined how Fresenius can leverage India's skilled workforce for the healthcare market. Additionally, Goyal engaged with Knauf Group regarding sustainable construction materials and manufacturing operations in India. These meetings highlight India's growing role in global healthcare and manufacturing.

articles.title: Zetwerk eyes manufacturing demand from AI, clean energy as shares debut
articles.desc: Shares of the business-to-business manufacturing platform opened at Rs 159 on the BSE, a 5.3% premium to the Rs 151 issue price, and at Rs 159.25 on the NSE. The stock subsequently gave up its gains to trade near the offer price amid weakness in broader markets.

articles.title: India October business growth hits 4-month high; hiring stalls, PMI shows
articles.desc: India's business activity expanded at its fastest pace in four months through a strong services-led pickup. The Composite Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 56.7 in October, exceeding forecasts due to increased orders. Despite this growth, hiring remained stagnant as companies managed workloads with current staff. Price pressures eased, resulting in lower input-cost inflation across both sectors. Overall, business confidence improved but remained below the average for the year.

articles.title: FCC grants Intel waiver for foreign-made robotic devices
articles.desc: The FCC said it would grant a one-year waiver of its rules in order to prevent "potential disruptions in the availability of domestic semiconductor manufacturing services for Intel's customers."

articles.title: Elon Musk wants to merge SpaceX and Tesla: Here's what to know
articles.desc: Elon Musk said this week that SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to study a merger of his two biggest companies. Musk cautioned that a merger is not certain.

articles.title: Swiggy shares crash 14%, hit 52-week low after Q2 results. Here’s why Jefferies, Nomura, Bernstein cut target price
articles.desc: Swiggy experienced a notable decline in share prices after announcing a Rs 922 crore loss for the quarter. Revenue from operations rose 36% year-on-year to Rs 7,571 crore, indicating some growth potential. However, the company's adjusted EBITDA loss widened, raising concerns among investors regarding its financial health. Analysts have revised target prices downward, citing challenges in the quick commerce segment.

articles.title: PHP security flaw: India activates emergency response; takes apps offline amid a global alert
articles.desc: Two critical security flaws in PHP, the programming language underpinning an estimated 70% of the internet, have triggered emergency cybersecurity measures in India. Banks are auditing applications and preparing backups, while the government is patching official websites. Razorpay has deployed AI-led vulnerability detection and warned merchants about potential breaches.

articles.title: SpaceX seeks access to 80,000 US cell sites for wireless network: report
articles.desc: SpaceX is in talks with cellular infrastructure companies to secure access to at least 80,000 sites across the United States, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Microsoft develops AI tool that can diagnose 'sequentially' like a doctor
articles.desc: Microsoft researchers say an AI tool that diagnoses patients step by step, as doctors do, was more than twice as accurate as general physicians at solving complex medical cases, according to a study published on Thursday in Science.

articles.title: FinTech M&A outlook improves, but investors remain selective on valuations: Report
articles.desc: Valuations of fintech companies have come under pressure across several segments as investors reassess businesses, while global fintech deal activity is showing signs of renewed momentum entering the fourth quarter of 2026, according to a report by D.A. Davidson.

articles.title: iPhone Duo's entire first week stock pre-booked in India
articles.desc: Apple Store in BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex), Mumbai, and Saket, New Delhi, have clocked maximum number of pre-bookings for the ultra premium first foldable iPhone from the company's stable.

articles.title: Rush is on to patch a software vulnerability that could impact 70% of websites worldwide
articles.desc: Many government sites appeared to be functioning normally Thursday, but outages or limited service continued while security work was under way.

articles.title: Knauf Group to invest additional €350 million in India, plans four new plants
articles.desc: German building materials company Knauf Group plans to invest an additional €350 million in India to set up four new manufacturing plants, Managing Partner Murat Akyildiz said after meeting Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal.

articles.title: Zetwerk Manufacturing shares list at 5% premium over IPO price
articles.desc: The Rs 5,012.33 crore IPO comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 2,830 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 14.45 crore shares worth approximately Rs 2,182 crore. While the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, the OFS proceeds will accrue to the selling shareholders.

articles.title: Swiggy narrows loss in Q2; eMudhra cofounder on what went wrong
articles.desc: Happy Friday! Swiggy reported a rise in revenue in Q2 FY27 while cutting its losses. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

articles.title: Blinkit, Instamart chart different paths to profitable growth
articles.desc: Eternal and Swiggy are adopting distinct strategies within the quick commerce and food delivery sectors. Eternal is ramping up Blinkit’s growth to achieve profitability, while Swiggy emphasizes the quality of its expansion. Through private-label investments and habit-forming efforts, Swiggy's Instamart aims to enhance customer engagement. Both companies project a robust 20% annual growth in food delivery as Blinkit and Instamart work to expand their reach.

articles.title: Surveillance and 'constant paranoia': Western diplomats tell BBC of life in war-time Moscow
articles.desc: Officials compare working in Russia since its full-scale invasion of Ukraine to the Cold War era.
